sentences.en: Don't let him draw you into a theological debate, or you'll be stuck there all night!
sentences.zh: 别让他把你拉进神学辩论，否则你会在那里纠缠一整晚！

sentences.en: Her interest in the theological aspects of Christianity led her to study at a seminary.
sentences.zh: 她对基督教神学方面的兴趣使她去神学院学习。

senses.zh: 神学的，神学上的,研究神学的
